rules: Liquidity of at least $25,000 (money sitting in the trading pool)
At least $10,000 traded in the last 24 hours
Trading pair at least 24 hours old
At least 100 trades in the last 24 hours
Not many buys with almost no sells: with 20+ buys, sells must be more than 5% of buys (a honeypot sign)
Liquidity at least 2% of market cap (harder to drain)

medium_risk: Liquidity of at least $50,000 (money sitting in the trading pool)
At least $10,000 traded in the last 24 hours
Trading pair at least 72 hours old
At least 200 trades in the last 24 hours
Not many buys with almost no sells: with 20+ buys, sells must be more than 5% of buys (a honeypot sign)
Liquidity at least 5% of market cap (harder to drain)
24h volume at least 50% of liquidity (shows real trading)
